nameInUI: Lua profiler (diagnostic -- slows the mission while it runs)
descriptionInUI: A diagnostic for a sim that hitches. Tick it for one flight, then untick it. It writes MooseProfiler.txt (time per Lua function) and PROFILER lines in dcs.log (one per stall) to Saved Games\DCS\Logs. The mission runs slower while it profiles.

specificOptions.descriptionInUI: Seconds after mission start before the function profiler hooks in. Leave spawn-in out of the window: every run hitches while models load.
Length of the profiling window. Five minutes covers the settled phase; the report is written when the window ends, or at mission end if that comes first.
A gap between two consecutive sim ticks longer than this is logged as a stall. 250 ms is a visible hitch; a one-second freeze reads ~1000.
